name: Empire State Building climbers
meaning: Two climbers stand atop a skyscraper spire holding a large banner high above the city. For broadcasting a message in the most dramatic, high-stakes way possible.
when_to_use: text1 = the message on the banner (right of the climbers, slightly rotated). Keep it short; the over-the-top delivery of a mundane or cheeky message is the joke.
